case.scenario: Propose headings for an internal frozen-fixture Civic Data draft.

messages.message: Outline a brief for the next Civic Data publication.
I prefer the source date in every Civic Data section heading so readers can spot freshness immediately.
Use placeholder dates in this example.
This next version is an internal draft built only from frozen fixtures.
Explain how its evidence limits should be labeled.
For internal Civic Data fixture drafts only, put one fixture-date note under the title instead of repeating dates in every heading.
Do not broaden that draft-only exception to public reports.
